Hello,

Some time ago I wrote Lean code for those lemma's that used my own low-level
Category Theory library.

I have ported the code to Mathlib.

I have to admit that some of the porting has been done with the help of Gemini 3.1 Pro in the Antigravity IDE.

I am not ashamed of it : the creativity (what) came from my part, the "heavy lifting" (how) has been done by AI.

The main result is an equivalence

coEndoYonedaEquiv
  {F : C ⥤ C} {X : C} :
    (CYEF X ⟶ (F ⋙ GEF)) ≃ (Global ((F ⋙ GEF).obj X))

similar to the classical coyonedaEquiv

where

  • C is a FunctionalCategory

and

  • CYEF X is the coyoneda endofunctor for X
  • GEF is the global endofunctor

and

  • Global is an abbrev of G Φ

where

  • G is an abbrev for making global elements (w.r.t. a Functor Φ of type Type u ⥤ C)

See : https://github.com/LucDuponcheelAtGitHub/coEndoYoneda

By the way, the lemma is, replacing elements by global elements, entirely pointfree.

All comments are welcome.
This topic was moved here from #general > CoYoneda lemmas for EndoFunctors of Functional Categories by Michael Rothgang.
